item.title: New Attack Bypasses TPM Lockout to Crack Windows Hello and BitLocker PINs in Days, Not Years
item.description: A flash-chip attack sidesteps the TPM's anti-hammering lockout, cutting Windows Hello and BitLocker PIN brute-force from years to days. PIN-only BitLocker is weaker than assumed.

item.title: 10-Year-Old NGINX HTTP/2 Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code on Servers
item.description: A decade-old NGINX HTTP/2 bug allows unauthenticated RCE. Patch any internet-facing NGINX with HTTP/2 enabled.
